title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE).

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Entry-level / New Grad: Linux command line, shell scripting/Python/Go, basic networking (DNS, HTTP, TCP), and containerization (Docker).
2. Mid-level: SLO/SLI definition, error budgets, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring, alerting hygiene, incident response on-call, and Kubernetes orchestration.
3. Senior: Distributed systems failure modes, multi-region disaster recovery, chaos engineering, capacity planning, and blameless postmortem culture.
4. Staff-plus: Organization-wide reliability architecture, global traffic engineering, and platform availability governance.

sections.heading: Question Strategy & Guidance
lines: - PREFER BRIEF PILLARS: Focus on candidate's infrastructure telemetry, incident management experience, and automation tools.
- Assess balance between software development (eliminating toil) and systems operations.
